Constants DEFAULT default static final  CacheKeyFactory   DEFAULT Default CacheKeyFactory . Public methods buildCacheKey abstract  String   buildCacheKey ( DataSpec  dataSpec) Returns the cache key of the resource containing the data defined by a DataSpec . Note that since the returned cache key corresponds to the whole resource, implementations must not return different cache keys for DataSpecs that define different ranges of the same resource. As a result, implementations should not use fields such as position and length . Parameters DataSpec  dataSpec The DataSpec . Returns String The cache key of the resource.
